title: A 3,000-Pound Walrus Hauls Itself Onto Ice With 3-Foot Tusks

scenes.text: This animal hauls 3,000 pounds with its tusks.
A walrus bull can weigh over 3,000 pounds.
Its tusks can grow up to three feet long.
It uses them to pull itself onto ice and land.
It also uses them to fight and to keep breathing holes open.
Herds on shore can run from dozens to thousands.

description:
A walrus bull can weigh over 3,000 pounds and uses tusks up to three feet long to pull itself out of the water.
Tusks also help in fights and keep breathing holes open in the ice.
Would you want to stand near a walrus herd?
first_comment: Would you rather meet a walrus or a polar bear?
